meta.name: eli5
meta.description: WHAT: Explains a codebase, a folder, a feature, a command or a pull request to someone who knows nothing about it, as a PR Lens canvas whose walkthrough builds the picture one part at a time. WHEN: /eli5 <thing>, or asked to explain code simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'. KEYWORDS: eli5, explain like I'm five, explain simply, beginner, onboarding, walkthrough, diagram, PR Lens

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把看不懂的代码或改动,一步步讲成图解让人听懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接手陌生代码库,或要给新人、非技术同事讲清代码
copy.tagline_en: Walk someone through unfamiliar code or a change, one part at a time, as a picture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just inherited unfamiliar code or must explain code to newcomers

howto.what: 让 Claude 解释代码时,它不写文字答案,而是产出一个 PR Lens 画布链接:画面从两个方框起步,一步步长出整张图,你打开链接按播放即可。
howto.when: 当你输入 `/eli5 <对象>`,或要求把代码讲得简单些、讲给新手或非工程师听时,它会接管。

say.note: 得到一个画布链接,从两个方框开始
链接里的图会一步步长到完整

say.text: 把这段代码像跟五岁小孩一样讲给我听

howto.what_en: When you ask Claude to explain code, it answers with a PR Lens canvas link instead of prose: the picture starts as two boxes and grows one part at a time until the whole thing is on screen. You open the link and press play.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you type `/eli5 <thing>`, or ask for code explained simply, to a beginner, a new hire, or a non-engineer.

say_en.note: Returns a canvas link starting with two boxes
The picture in the link grows step by step

say_en.text: Explain this code like I'm five
say_en.note: Plain words, a couple of parts at a time
